seed: sunny green-hill kingdom, cheerful and colorful, gentle water pools and spike pits, playful bouncy enemies

story.seed: sunny green-hill kingdom, cheerful and colorful, gentle water pools and spike pits, playful bouncy enemies

l1.brief: A long breezy run across rolling hills dotted with wildflowers, with gentle slopes and shallow sparkling puddles to hop over as a warm welcome to the kingdom.

l2.brief: A winding vertical climb up a tiered hillside of stacked grassy ledges and bouncy mushroom platforms, ascending toward a sky filled with drifting clouds.

l3.brief: A relentless jump gauntlet across a chain of narrow flower-topped platforms suspended above a glittering meadow pool, demanding precise timing with critters bouncing unpredictably underfoot.

l4.brief: A winding horizontal run through tangled root corridors and oversized mushroom caps, with spike pits hidden beneath deceptively mossy platforms and nimble dart-beetles weaving unpredictably between low branches.

l5.brief: A steep vertical climb up a colossal ancient tree trunk, leaping between gnarled bark ledges and swaying fungal shelves while aggressive tree-hoppers ambush from above and dislodging roots collapse underfoot.

l6.brief: A relentless aerial jump gauntlet across the highest canopy layer, hopping between tiny leaf platforms, bouncing mushroom tops, and crumbling branch tips with no ground beneath and swooping moth-hawks attacking mid-jump.

l7.brief: Navigate crumbling stone corridors and collapsing bridges in a long horizontal run through the citadel's outer ramparts, where armored sentinels patrol narrow ledges above deadly drops.

l8.brief: Scale the cracked interior tower in a punishing vertical climb, leaping between shifting stone platforms and dodging spear-throwers perched on crumbling archways.

l9.brief: Race across the citadel's exposed rooftop in a treacherous spike-gauntlet finale, timing every jump between collapsing tiles and elite crown-guards to seize the stolen crown.

stats.flavor: A slow-rolling ball of tangled clover and stubbornness that perks up the moment it spots an intruder, picking up speed and trundling relentlessly across any terrain until it drives the trespasser out of its territory.
A pudgy, round little creature that bounces in cheerful fixed arcs along hilltops and meadows, harmless-looking but surprisingly painful to run into mid-hop.
A gossamer wisp that hovers perfectly still above a favourite wildflower, batting its translucent wings just enough to hold position and bumping any passerby who strays within reach.
A stout little stone-shelled critter that plods back and forth across any terrain it calls home, too stubborn to stop and too slow to worry about.

A stubby-legged, perpetually sniffling critter that catches your scent from across the hilltop and waddles after you with surprising persistence, its round belly swaying side to side as it huffs and charges.
A plump, gilded beetle that ambles unhurriedly across every corner of the kingdom, its polished shell catching sunlight as it patrols back and forth with self-important dignity.
A plump, glassy-eyed creature that lazily paddles in circles across puddles, ponds, and any shallow water it can find, bumping into swimmers with cheerful obliviousness.
